## Checklist

- [ ] `python tests/test_skills.py` prints `OK: N skill folders validated`
- [ ] Frontmatter `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] No em dashes in prose
- [ ] Every benchmark or example number cites a verifiable source or is labeled illustrative
- [ ] Nothing in the skill sends email or SMS, or tells an agent to send
- [ ] Tool names and API shapes defer to klaviyo-labs/agent-context and the live catalog, not copied into the skill
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under an Unreleased heading
